data.output:
{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -l
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --nodes=6
#   --ntasks=96
#   --time=00:30:00

#flux: -N 6
#flux: -n 96
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=30m

source /ssoft/spack/bin/slmodules.sh -r stable

module purge
module load gcc/5.3.0 mvapich2/2.2b openblas/0.2.18 cp2k/3.0-mpi
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1

date_start=$(date +%s)

# Slurm used srun; under Flux, use flux-run to launch MPI ranks.
flux run -n 96 -c 1 cp2k.popt -i *.inp -o output.out

date_end=$(date +%s)
time_run=$((date_end-date_start))
echo "096_cpus $time_run seconds"

rm -f GTH_BASIS_SETS POTENTIAL *xyz *restart
"
}
